children: Lite Strategy, Inc. reported a net loss of $(71.2M) for fiscal 2026, a deterioration from a $(15.9M) loss in FY 2025, as the company reported no revenue in either year and continued to reposition its balance sheet and R&D priorities.
Revenue: No revenues were reported in FY 2026 or FY 2025; operations generated no sales in both years.
Net income: Net loss of $(71.2M) for FY 2026, compared with a net loss of $(15.9M) in FY 2025 (worsened by $(55.2M) YoY).
Diluted EPS: Net loss per share (basic and diluted) $(2.06) for FY 2026, versus $(2.39) for FY 2025.

Strategic pivot to Litecoin treasury: In August 2025 the company shifted its primary reserve strategy to Litecoin (LTC), deploying proceeds from a $100M PIPE completed in July 2025 to acquire LTC and establish digital-asset treasury operations.
Pipeline and R&D: The company discontinued oncology clinical programs in 2024 and resumed preclinical R&D in non-oncologic indications for voruciclib while maintaining development of zandelisib.
Capital markets and liquidity actions: Following the PIPE, management initiated a covered call options program and began share repurchases to monetize LTC exposure and manage capital.
Cost reductions: Workforce reductions and cuts to clinical spending drove a roughly 97% year-over-year decline in R&D expense and an 11% decline in G&A, reflecting lower personnel and legal costs.

Derivative and treasury risk management: The company implemented covered call arrangements with GSR to generate income, recording notable fair-value volatility impacts and continuing to monitor digital-asset related risks.
